items.name: code-review
items.description: Reviews pull requests against our engineering checklist and flags risky changes before merge.
items.body:
# code-review

Reviews pull requests against our engineering checklist and flags risky changes before merge.

## Owner
Platform team

items.name: review-pr
items.description: Reviews the current branch or a pull request diff against the team checklist: naming, tests, error handling and migration safety. Use when the user asks for a code review or PR review.
items.body:
## When to use
- Before opening a pull request
- When a reviewer asks for a second opinion

## Steps
1. Collect the diff with `scripts/collect_diff.sh`
2. Check every file against `reference/checklist.md`
3. Report findings grouped by severity: blocking, should fix, nit

```bash
git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat
```

items.name: security-review
items.description: Checks a diff for injection risks, leaked secrets, unsafe deserialization and missing authorization checks. Use when changes touch auth, input handling or infrastructure.

items.name: code-reviewer
items.description: A read-only reviewer subagent that inspects changed files in parallel and returns a prioritized list of findings with file and line references.

items.name: review
items.description: Runs the full review on the current branch and posts a summary you can paste into the pull request.

items.name: test-writer
items.description: Writes and repairs unit and end-to-end tests that follow the conventions of each repository.
items.body:
# test-writer

Writes and repairs unit and end-to-end tests that follow the conventions of each repository.

## Owner
QA guild

items.name: write-unit-tests
items.description: Writes unit tests for a function, module or diff using the test framework already in the repository. Use when the user asks for tests or coverage.
items.body:
## When to use
- New code without tests
- A bug fix that needs a regression test

## Rules
- Detect the framework from `package.json` before writing anything
- One behaviour per test, named after the behaviour
- Never mock the module under test

items.name: e2e-playwright
items.description: Creates Playwright end-to-end tests for a user flow, with stable selectors and fixtures. Use when the user describes a flow to cover in the browser.

items.name: test-engineer
items.description: Investigates failing or flaky tests, finds the root cause and proposes the smallest fix.
